warnings: This charter is PROVISIONAL and directional. The user supplied only a URL and a one-line description: no business decision, no estimand choice, no target population, no locale list, no competitor list, no surface budget, no customer corpus, and no approver. Every field below is an agent-stated assumption pending human Gate 1-4 approval.
No 'AI visibility score' is defined. A single blended score is rejected by the charter contract because it would mix aided statuses, lanes and denominators.
Exposure-weighted and priority-weighted results are kept in separate rollups and neither may be reported as market share, audience reach, awareness or revenue attribution.
business_decision: PROVISIONAL/ASSUMED: decide where to invest answer-engine content, documentation and third-party-evidence work across the target's five stated product areas, by first establishing a repeatable baseline of how assistants answer the buyer questions this panel enumerates. This charter does not authorise any claim about market position, demand size or revenue.

estimands.name: unaided_brand_presence
estimands.numerator: Eligible observations in which the target brand or a target product name appears anywhere in the assistant's answer text.
estimands.denominator: All valid observations from canonical cells with aided_status = 'unaided' AND partition IN ('core','sentinel'), within one lane, one surface, one locale and one wave.
estimands.does_not_prove: Does not prove awareness, preference, market share, audience reach, or that any human ever issued these prompts. It is a property of this prompt panel under this configuration.

estimands.name: unaided_brand_presence
estimands.numerator: Eligible observations in which the target brand or a target product name appears in the answer.
estimands.denominator: All valid observations from cells with aided_status = 'category_aided', held in a SEPARATE denominator from est-unaided-presence.
estimands.does_not_prove: Naming a solution category is itself a prompt, not buyer behaviour. This rate may not be pooled with the unaided rate.

estimands.name: competitive_mention_share
estimands.numerator: Distinct answers naming the target, per named vendor.
estimands.denominator: All valid observations in the same cell set that name at least one vendor of any kind; reported as a per-vendor rate with the full vendor list, never as a single leaderboard percentage when a stratum has fewer than 20 distinct cells.
estimands.does_not_prove: Mention share in a prompt panel is not market share, revenue share, or consideration-set share.

estimands.name: citation_presence
estimands.numerator: Observations in which a target-owned domain appears in exposed citation metadata.
estimands.denominator: Valid observations in the retrieval and consumer_surface lanes ONLY, where retrieval actually ran and citations were exposed.
estimands.does_not_prove: Does not prove traffic, clicks, influence on the reader, or that the cited page caused the answer.

estimands.name: answer_framing
estimands.numerator: Observations coded against a pre-registered framing codebook (problem framing used, capability attributed, limitation attributed, plan/tier attributed, accuracy of attributed fact).
estimands.denominator: Valid observations within a single cell set, lane, surface and wave; reported per code, never collapsed into one score.
estimands.does_not_prove: Framing coding is inter-rater dependent; no codebook or rater agreement has been established yet. Pending Gate 4.

estimands.name: aided_brand_knowledge
estimands.numerator: B0 target-aided observations in which the assistant returns a factually correct, source-checkable statement about the named target capability, plan or incident.
estimands.denominator: Valid observations from cells with aided_status = 'target_aided' ONLY, in a denominator shared with no other aided status.
estimands.does_not_prove: Aided accuracy says nothing about whether the target is reached unaided.

estimands_declared_out_of_scope.name: campaign_response
estimands_declared_out_of_scope.reason: No campaign, campaign terms, campaign dates, treatment definition, pre-registration or matched control set were supplied. The campaign_experiment lane is defined but not instantiated. No causal or before/after campaign claim may be made from this panel.

target_population: The population of interest is a PROMPT-SPACE population: the set of evidence-supported canonical buyer-intent cells enumerated in prompt_architecture.json, covering site/content operators, small online-business operators, platform/SRE engineers, and workforce-access IT/security engineers. This is explicitly NOT a population of AI users, and no probability sample of AI users exists in this run.
exclusions: Consumers of the target's free DNS resolver as an end-user product (no buyer-job evidence in this manifest).
Domain registration and email-routing jobs (no evidence in this manifest).
Any job requiring individual-level personal data.
Non-English locales other than the single en-GB rotating probe: no locale evidence and no market-competent reviewer available.
Edge-compute and serverless-storage jobs beyond a rotating discovery probe: capability is company-asserted (src-001) but no buyer-behaviour evidence exists (src-016).
products: Application security (WAF, DDoS mitigation, bot management)
Zero Trust / SASE / secure workforce access
Edge compute and developer platform (declared low-evidence; rotating only)
markets: Global English-language public web, with no market-size or share claim

surfaces.label: Search AI answer panel, clean archetype

lanes.policy: No external search, tools, files, RAG or history. Fixed system prompt, declared model/version, fixed sampling, fresh session per observation.
Retrieval recorded as required/allowed/unavailable; whether retrieval ran; generated queries and citation metadata captured when exposed; live vs cached state recorded.
Clean archetype only in v0.1.0: new account, no history, no personalisation, declared device and locale. Never rolled up with API lanes.
Defined but empty. Requires pre-registration, treatment/control definition and matched unaffected controls before use.

run_budget.basis: 86 accepted candidates in fully-eligible partitions x 3 repeats x 6 surface-lane combinations, plus reduced-lane rotating and control allocation. See panel.yaml for the exact derivation.

precision_note: No variance pilot has been run. No target precision, minimum detectable difference or power calculation may be stated until the sentinel pilot in panel.yaml completes over at least two time blocks.
